examples.name: Spread all launcher variables
examples.before: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH }; }

examples.name: Forward worker authentication to task
examples.before: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH }; }
examples.after: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH, WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN: process.env.WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN }; }

examples.name: Explicit non-sensitive allowlist
examples.after: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH, LANG: process.env.LANG }; }

examples.name: Named nested runtime contract
examples.before: export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH }; }
examples.after:
// The nested Node service requires NODE_OPTIONS to set its heap limit.
export function taskEnv() { return { PATH: process.env.PATH, NODE_OPTIONS: "--max-old-space-size=512" }; }

examples.name: Scrub captured worker token before launch
examples.before: export function launch(spawn, binary, capturedEnv) { return spawn(binary, [], { env: capturedEnv }); }
